<blog>

# Warkop Betawa — Digital Menu & Order System

## 1. Project Introduction

**Warkop Betawa** is a Next.js-based restaurant ordering application designed for QR dine-in experiences. The system provides customers with a digital menu, cart management, and order placement functionality while offering administrators tools to manage menu items, categories, promotions, coupons, and orders.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Digital Menu Experience**: Replace physical menus with an interactive, searchable digital catalog
- **QR Dine-In Integration**: Enable table-based ordering through QR code scanning
- **Real-time Order Management**: Provide live order status tracking for both customers and staff
- **Promotional System**: Support discounts, coupons, and promotional pricing
- **Admin Dashboard**: Comprehensive backend management for restaurant operations

### Target Audience
- **Restaurant Customers**: End users who scan QR codes to browse menus and place orders
- **Restaurant Staff**: Kitchen and service personnel managing orders and inventory
- **Restaurant Administrators**: Managers overseeing menu, promotions, and business settings

## 2. Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern Next.js 14 architecture with a hybrid data layer supporting both PostgreSQL (via Prisma) and MongoDB capabilities.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Next.js App Router] --> B[API Routes]
    A --> C[Client Components]
    B --> D[Prisma Client]
    D --> E[(PostgreSQL Database)]
    C --> F[Local Storage]
    C --> G[State Management]
    H[AI Chat] --> I[Google Gemini API]
    J[Supabase Auth] --> K[JWT Tokens]
    
    subgraph "Frontend Layer"
        C
        F
        G
    end
    
    subgraph "Backend Layer"
        B
        D
    end
    
    subgraph "Data Layer"
        E
    end
```

### Component Breakdown

**Core Application Structure:**
- **App Router**: Next.js 14 file-based routing system
- **Server Components**: Data fetching and server-side rendering
- **Client Components**: Interactive UI elements with React state
- **API Routes**: RESTful endpoints for data operations

**Design Patterns:**
- **Repository Pattern**: Centralized database access through Prisma
- **Event-Driven State Management**: Custom event emitters for cross-component communication
- **Caching Strategy**: In-memory caching for frequently accessed menu data
- **Component Composition**: Reusable UI components with props and slots

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Customer as Customer Browser
    participant MenuPage as Menu Page
    participant API as API Routes
    participant Cache as Menu Cache
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    
    Customer->>+MenuPage: Browse Menu
    MenuPage->>+Cache: Check cached menu
    alt Cache Hit
        Cache-->>-MenuPage: Return cached data
    else Cache Miss
        MenuPage->>+API: GET /api/menu
        API->>+DB: Query menu items
        DB-->>-API: Return data
        API->>+Cache: Store in cache
        API-->>-MenuPage: Response
    end
    MenuPage-->>-Customer: Display menu
```

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Application Root** (`app/layout.tsx`):
- Global metadata configuration
- Theme setup with Indonesian language support
- Client layout wrapper initialization

**Home Page** (`app/page.tsx`):
- Redirects to main menu page
- Simple entry point for the application

**Menu Interface** (`app/menu/page.tsx`):
- Primary customer-facing interface
- Real-time menu browsing with category filtering
- Shopping cart integration
- Search functionality

### Core Modules

**Database Layer** (`lib/db.ts`):
- Automatic database seeding on first run
- Memory store fallback for development
- Coupon initialization and management
- Table token generation for QR system

**State Management** (`lib/store.ts`):
- Local storage-based cart persistence
- Event-driven state synchronization
- Table session management
- Cross-component communication patterns

**Prisma Configuration** (`lib/prisma.ts`):
- Singleton pattern for Prisma client
- Development logging and debugging
- Connection pooling optimization

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Configuration** (`package.json`):
- Next.js development and build scripts
- Dependency management for React ecosystem
- Prisma integration and skills sync

**Database Schema** (`prisma/schema.prisma`):
- Relational data model for PostgreSQL
- Menu items, categories, orders, and settings
- Indexing strategies for performance optimization

### External Dependencies

**Core Framework**:
- Next.js 16.3.4 - Full-stack React framework
- React 18.3.1 - UI component library
- TypeScript 5.5.4 - Type safety and developer experience

**Database & ORM**:
- Prisma 5.22.0 - Type-safe database client
- Supabase - PostgreSQL hosting and authentication

**AI Integration**:
- Google Generative AI - AI chat assistant
- Google GenAI - Advanced AI capabilities

**UI & Styling**:
- Tailwind CSS 3.4.10 - Utility-first styling
- Lucide React - Icon library
- clsx & tailwind-merge - Conditional class management

### Integration Points

**Authentication** (`lib/jwt.ts`):
- JWT token generation for table sessions
- Secure QR code validation
- Session management for dine-in tables

**Caching Strategy** (`lib/menuCache.ts`):
- In-memory LRU cache for menu data
- Cache invalidation on updates
- Performance optimization for high-traffic scenarios

**Format Utilities** (`lib/format.ts`):
- Indonesian Rupiah currency formatting
- Date and time formatting utilities
- Consistent number formatting across the app

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Menu Management**:
- Dynamic menu display with real-time updates
- Category-based filtering and search
- Spice level customization
- Add-on item selection
- Badge system for featured items

**Order Processing**:
- Shopping cart with persistent storage
- Table-based order association
- Real-time order status tracking
- Live polling for order updates

**Administrative Tools**:
- Menu CRUD operations
- Category management
- Promotion and coupon system
- Order monitoring and management
- Restaurant settings configuration

### Implementation Highlights

**Responsive Design** (`components/Header.tsx`, `components/FloatingCart.tsx`):
- Mobile-first responsive layout
- Touch-friendly interface elements
- Adaptive navigation patterns
- Optimized for QR code scanning devices

**Performance Optimization**:
- Server-side caching for menu data
- Lazy loading of images and components
- Efficient state management with minimal re-renders
- Optimized database queries with proper indexing

**User Experience Enhancements**:
- Smooth animations and transitions
- Intuitive gesture controls
- Real-time feedback for user actions
- Accessible interface design

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> MenuBrowsing
    MenuBrowsing --> ItemSelection: Select Item
    ItemSelection --> CartManagement: Add to Cart
    CartManagement --> Checkout: Proceed to Order
    Checkout --> OrderConfirmation: Submit Order
    OrderConfirmation --> OrderTracking: Track Status
    OrderTracking --> MenuBrowsing: New Order
    
    state CartManagement {
        [*] --> ReviewItems
        ReviewItems --> ModifyQuantity: Update Qty
        ReviewItems --> RemoveItem: Delete Item
        ModifyQuantity --> ReviewItems
        RemoveItem --> ReviewItems
    }
```
